intro: Over 40 articles published between April 12 and May 16, 2026, covered Microsoft-related security developments, with a severity mix including 20 high and 6 critical reports. Threat actors Secret Blizzard and Storm-2755 were observed in these incidents. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-21643 and CVE-2026-40372, both carrying a CVSS score of 9.1, alongside CVE-2026-40361, CVE-2026-40364, and CVE-2026-41103 at 8.4. Affected sectors spanned enterprise, technology, government, and cross-sector environments, while regions impacted included Global, Asia, Canada, Europe, and Japan.
